questions.text: What is the fear that keeps you up at night?
questions.verse_text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
follow_up_hints: He makes us dwell in safety

questions.text: When you feel anxious, where do you feel it in your body?
questions.verse_text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

questions.text: Is there a specific situation you're dreading?
questions.verse_text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

questions.text: What do you think is the root of your fear - what's the worst thing that could happen?
questions.verse_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

questions.text: Has fear ever stopped you from doing something you knew God was calling you to?
questions.verse_text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
follow_up_hints: Spirit of power, love, sound mind

questions.text: What would you do differently if you weren't afraid?
questions.verse_text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

questions.text: Can you remember a time when you faced a fear and God was faithful?
questions.verse_text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

questions.text: How do you usually cope with anxiety - in healthy or unhealthy ways?
questions.verse_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

questions.text: If God said 'Do not fear' 365 times in the Bible - one for each day - which day's fear is yours today?
questions.verse_text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

questions.text: Would you like to surrender your fear to God together right now?
questions.verse_text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
